Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the NHAI and learned counsel for the respondents.

2. The petitioners have filed the present petition for Patna High Court CWJC No.6539 of 2023 dt.20-07-2023 grant of compensation amount of enhanced rate which has been made for Kumari Kiran Sinha vs The State Of Bihar on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/60472189/
1 construction of NH-31.
3.

entities.text: Kumari Kiran Sinha vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of respondent Nos. 3 and 4 in which it has been accepted that the petitioners' land was acquired and for some part of the land, compensation has been received but for some part, compensation has not been received.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have grievances that though the compensation amount has been granted, but the same is at a lower rate.
The petitioners want their payment of compensation at a very higher rate.

5. It has been admitted by both the parties that award has already been prepared and as such, after the preparation of the award, the only remedy left to the petitioners is to file his application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Commissioner, Patna.
6.

In this view of the matter, petitioners are directed to file his application under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 within eight weeks from today along with a copy of this order before the Arbitrator-cum-Divisional Patna High Court CWJC No.6539 of 2023 dt.20-07-2023 Commissioner, Patna who shall take appropriate decision in accordance with law in this matter.
7. With the aforesaid observation and direction, the present writ petition stands disposed of.
(Dr. Anshuman, J) Ashwini/-
